shortDescription: KVS NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Tier-II Result 2026 declared. Check CBSE / recruitment portal for scorecard and shortlist.
content:
KVS and NVS Teaching & Non-Teaching Tier-II Result 2026 has been released for candidates who appeared in the Tier-II stage of recruitment examinations conducted through the CBSE recruitment process.

The update covers teaching posts (such as PRT, TGT, PGT) and non-teaching categories as notified in the original advertisements of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan and Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti.

How to check

  1. Visit cbse.gov.in or the linked result portal
  2. Open KVS / NVS Tier-II Result notice
  3. Download PDF or login for scorecard
  4. Note interview / document verification schedule if shortlisted
